root_idea.summary: The root centers on an impressed أثر or معلم: a mark or sign that identifies something and can be recognized as evidence.
root_idea.development: From making or bearing a mark, the lexicon develops meanings for identifying signs, discerning a thing through its outward signs, and things that mark or serve as landmarks, including seasonal rain and a gathering place.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form وَسَمَ rather than the Quranic imperfect lemma identity.
Displayed under the normalized singular active-participle citation form مُتَوَسِّمٌ.

senses.definition: To mark or brand someone with an identifying sign.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction, the mark is placed on a person as a recognizable sign. The verb's broader physical marking use is the same lexical branch, while the attested passage specifically describes branding a person.

senses.definition: One who discerns a thing's real state or character from its outward signs.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic participle denotes people who examine signs and form a sound perception from them; the usage is associated with discernment, sagacity, or keen perception.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stigmatize or figuratively mark someone with a distinguishing description, including through satire or speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of marking; the attributed quality may be adverse, such as a stigma, or favorable, such as being marked by goodness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To place a superscription or title on a book or writing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of assigning an identifying title to written material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be beautiful in face or to bear the impress of beauty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive description of a person's appearance; related nouns include وَسَامَةٌ and وَسَامٌ.
An adjectival description of physical beauty.
The quality of being beautiful or bearing an impress of beauty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A brand or mark, especially one made with a hot iron; more broadly, an identifying sign, badge, token, or symptom.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the mark itself rather than the act of marking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A title or superscription of a book or writing.
A woad- or indigo-like plant whose leaves are used for tinting or dyeing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plant-name associated with coloring the hands or other materials.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first rain of a season.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name reflects the rain's marking of the land through the vegetation it produces.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A periodic festival or fair; specifically, the fair and meeting place of pilgrims.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A gathering place or occasion marked out for recurring communal assembly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attend or take part in a موسم, especially a festival or pilgrimage gathering.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional usage equivalent to attending the designated seasonal gathering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek the wasmī seasonal rain or the pasture associated with it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct traditional use of the Form V verb, separate from discerning through outward signs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A branding or marking instrument; also a brand or mark made with a hot iron.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can denote either the tool used for marking or the resulting impress.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An impress or character of beauty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a visible sign of physical beauty borne by a person.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The general act of marking an object is covered by the Quranic marking sense; the trader reference adds no separate branch.
General marking is covered by the identifying-mark sense.
Beauty and the impress of beauty.
Brand, identifying sign, and written title.
Name for the first seasonal rain.
Brand or mark made with a hot iron.

cautions: The Mufradat discussion also cites sīma forms in Quranic passages, but no corresponding QAC form group is supplied; that evidence is retained under the classical سِمَةٌ entry rather than assigned to a Quranic form.
